captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a custom bracket mount designed to hold a Wii sensor bar on top of a flat-screen TV. One side features a wide rectangular socket with two cylindrical alignment pins on the inner edges to securely clip the sensor bar. The opposite side features an angled, open-ended channel designed to hook over the top edge of a television frame. A solid wedge-shaped transition piece fills the space between the angled TV hanger and the straight sensor bracket, ensuring structural rigidity.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric Wii sensor bar stand that clips onto the top edge of a TV. The design must include adjustable parameters for the TV edge width, TV edge depth, and the mounting angle of the sensor bar. It should feature a front-facing rectangular pocket with dual cylindrical retention pins to hold the sensor bar, a rear-facing angled bracket to hook over the TV frame, and a solid transition wedge joining the two sections.
captions.factory: The design is split into three main components assembled together. First, the Wii sensor holder is constructed using a difference() operation subtracting a smaller cube from a larger cube, with two cylinder() primitives added at the open edges as retention pins. Second, the TV edge holder is generated with a difference() of cubes, rotated by the angle parameter 'a'. Finally, a wedge-shaped fill piece is formed using an intersection() of a rotated cube representing the angled extension and a straight axis-aligned bounding cube.
